info.name: Stark Bank Balance Split Receiver API

params.name: after
params.description: Filter entities created after this date.

params.name: before
params.description: Filter entities created before this date.

params.name: cursor
params.description: String used to get the next batch of results. Our SDKs handle this for you.

params.name: fields
params.description: List of strings to filter response JSON keys. Not available in the SDKs.

params.name: ids
params.description: List of strings to get specific entities by ids.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results per cursor. Max = 100.

params.name: receiverIds
params.description: List of receiver ids to filter retrieved objects. ex: ['5656565656565656', '4545454545454545'].

params.name: status
params.description: Filter split receivers by the specified status.

params.name: tags
params.description: Filter entities that contain the specified tags.

params.name: taxId
params.description: filter for splitReceivers sent to the specified tax ID. ex: '012.345.678-90'

params.name: transactionIds
params.description: List of transaction IDs linked to the desired splitReceivers. ex: ['5656565656565656', '4545454545454545']
